faq.title: Questions buyers and renters ask us

items.q: How do I book a viewing?
items.a: Pick a home from the list, send a request through the form below, and the listing agent will call you to agree a time.

items.q: Do you charge to browse listings?
items.a: No. Browsing listings and booking a viewing are free. Fees apply only when a purchase, sale or lease is completed, and they are confirmed in writing first.

items.q: Can I rent if I am new to the city?
items.a: Yes. Bring a valid ID and proof of income or employment. Your agent will explain which documents each landlord asks for.

items.q: What documents do I need to buy?
items.a: A valid ID, proof of funds and the ownership documents for the home. Your agent checks the ownership papers before you sign anything.
We explain the steps and introduce you to banks our buyers have used, but the loan decision always sits with the bank.

items.q: What happens after I make an offer?
items.a: Your agent puts the offer in writing, the seller replies, and once terms are agreed both sides sign a reservation agreement before the final contract.
